mapper.select: SELECT version_id, model_id, version, release_date, changelog, is_current, upgrade_status, create_time FROM ai_model_version WHERE model_id = #{modelId} ORDER BY is_current DESC, release_date DESC, version_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_model_version WHERE model_id = #{modelId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_model_version (model_id, version, release_date, changelog, is_current, upgrade_status) VALUES (#{modelId}, #{version}, #{releaseDate}, #{changelog}, IFNULL(#{isCurrent}, 0), IFNULL(#{upgradeStatus}, 'PENDING'))
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ai_model_version WHERE model_id = #{modelId} AND upgrade_status = 'PENDING' AND is_current = 0
